claim: Mammalian TgfbrI/Alk5 has two paralogs in zebrafish, alk5a and alk5b.
source: Mammalian TgfbrI/Alk5 has two paralogs in zebrafish, alk5a and alk5b, and from multiple datasets (Pauli et al., 2012; Yang et al., 2013; Gauvrit et al., 2018; Mullapudi et al., 2018), we found alk5b to be the highest expressed paralog during embryogenesis.
evidence: The claim is directly stated in the manuscript text and supported by citations to multiple datasets.

claim: alk5b is the highest expressed paralog during embryogenesis.
source: Mammalian TgfbrI/Alk5 has two paralogs in zebrafish, alk5a and alk5b, and from multiple datasets (Pauli et al., 2012; Yang et al., 2013; Gauvrit et al., 2018; Mullapudi et al., 2018), we found alk5b to be the highest expressed paralog during embryogenesis.
evidence: The claim is supported by data from multiple cited datasets.

claim: alk5b expression is detected in the neural tube starting at 30 hpf.
source: We detected alk5b expression in the neural tube starting at 30 hpf and in the gut at 72 hpf (Figure 1—figure supplement 1A–D').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by reference to figure supplement showing expression patterns.

claim: alk5b expression is detected in the gut at 72 hpf.
source: We detected alk5b expression in the neural tube starting at 30 hpf and in the gut at 72 hpf (Figure 1—figure supplement 1A–D').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by reference to figure supplement showing expression patterns.

claim: In the developing cardiovascular system, alk5b reporter expression appears to be restricted to the heart.
source: Notably, in the developing cardiovascular system, alk5b reporter expression appears to be restricted to the heart (Figure 1A,B), as we could not detect GFP expression in any other vascular beds (Figure 1—figure supplement 1B,B').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing GFP expression patterns.

claim: alk5b is expressed in both ECs and SMCs in the OFT.
source: Within the heart, we detected alk5b expression in the OFT (Figure 1A–B''), where it is localized in both ECs and SMCs (Figure 1B', B'').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing cellular localization.

claim: alk5a mutants carry a 4 bp deletion leading to predicted generation of truncated proteins lacking the kinase domain.
source: We obtained a 4 bp and a 8 bp deletion in alk5a and alk5b, respectively, each leading to the predicted generation of truncated proteins, lacking the kinase domain (Figure 1—figure supplement 1E).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by a figure showing the mutation effects.

claim: alk5b mutants carry an 8 bp deletion leading to predicted generation of truncated proteins lacking the kinase domain.
source: We obtained a 4 bp and a 8 bp deletion in alk5a and alk5b, respectively, each leading to the predicted generation of truncated proteins, lacking the kinase domain (Figure 1—figure supplement 1E).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by a figure showing the mutation effects.

claim: alk5a and alk5b mutant mRNA levels are decreased in the respective mutant fish.
source: Moreover, alk5a and alk5b mutant mRNA levels are decreased in the respective mutant fish while the other paralog does not appear to be upregulated, suggesting mutant mRNA degradation but a lack of transcriptional adaptation (El-Brolosy et al., 2019; Figure 1—figure supplement 1F).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by data shown in a figure supplement, with citation to transcriptional adaptation literature.

claim: Single alk5a mutant larvae do not exhibit any gross morphological defects other than the lack of inflation of the swim bladder in alk5b-/- larvae.
source: Single alk5a and alk5b mutant larvae do not exhibit any gross morphological defects, other than the lack of inflation of the swim bladder in alk5b-/- larvae (Figure 1—figure supplement 1G–I).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing larval morphology.

claim: alk5-/- larvae start exhibiting pericardial edema at 72 hpf.
source: Loss of Alk5 function does not lead to early developmental defects until 72 hpf, when alk5-/- larvae start exhibiting pericardial edema, more evident at 96 hpf (Figure 1—figure supplement 1J), suggesting defective cardiac function.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing the phenotype.

claim: alk5 mutants exhibit a specific increase in OFT width by 54 hpf.
source: By analyzing heart morphology in live Tg(kdrl:EGFP) alk5-/- embryos, we observed a specific increase in OFT width by 54 hpf (Figure 1C–H).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data and quantification.

claim: By 78 hpf, the dilation of the alk5 mutant OFT between systole and diastole is more than twice as large as in wild type.
source: Live imaging of beating hearts showed that, by 78 hpf, the dilation of the alk5 mutant OFT between systole and diastole is more than twice as large as in wild type (Figure 1I–K; Figure 1—videos 1 and 2).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by live imaging data and quantification.

claim: The abnormal expansion of the OFT in alk5 mutants is accompanied by its inability to pump blood into the connecting vessels, leading to retrograde flow into the ventricle.
source: This abnormal expansion of the OFT is accompanied by its inability to pump blood into the connecting vessels, leading to retrograde flow into the ventricle (Figure 1—video 3).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by video data showing blood flow patterns.

claim: In 78 hpf wild-type zebrafish, the OFT is connected to the aortic arches by a single vessel, the ventral aorta (VA).
source: In 78 hpf wild-type zebrafish, the OFT is connected to the aortic arches by a single vessel, the ventral aorta (VA) (Figure 1—figure supplement 1K).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing vascular anatomy.

claim: alk5-/- animals fail to form the ventral aorta and instead display two independent vessels from the OFT to the left and right aortic arches.
source: alk5-/- animals fail to form this vessel; instead, they display two independent vessels from the OFT to the left and right aortic arches (Figure 1—figure supplement 1L).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing vascular anatomy.

claim: A few alk5 mutant OFTs exhibited clear ruptures in their endothelial layer at 96 hpf.
source: Furthermore, a few alk5 mutant OFTs exhibited clear ruptures in their endothelial layer at 96 hpf (Figure 1L,L'; Figure 1—video 4).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing endothelial ruptures.

claim: 7 out of 11 alk5-/- larvae displayed dextran accumulation between the ECs and SMCs in the OFT and in the interstitial space amongst SMCs.
source: To investigate this phenotype, we injected dextran into the circulation and 7 out of 11 alk5-/- larvae displayed dextran accumulation between the ECs and SMCs in the OFT and in the interstitial space amongst SMCs, a phenotype not observed in alk5+/+ larvae (n = 10; Figure 1M,N).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by experimental data from dextran injection experiments.

claim: The cardiovascular defects in alk5 mutant fish are restricted to the OFT and the VA, while all other vascular beds appear morphologically unaffected.
source: Notably, the cardiovascular defects in alk5 mutant fish are restricted to the OFT and the VA, while all other vascular beds appear morphologically unaffected.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text based on observations of vascular morphology.

claim: The diameter of the dorsal aorta (DA) appears unaffected in alk5 mutants compared with wild-type siblings at 56 and 96 hpf.
source: The diameter of the dorsal aorta (DA) appears unaffected in alk5 mutants compared with wild-type siblings at 56 and 96 hpf (Figure 1—figure supplement 1M), and the atrium and ventricle appear correctly shaped at 78 hpf (Figure 1—figure supplement 1N,O).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification data shown in a figure supplement.

claim: After the onset of the OFT phenotype, alk5-/- larvae exhibit retrograde blood flow through the atrioventricular canal.
source: However, after the onset of the OFT phenotype, alk5-/- larvae also exhibit retrograde blood flow through the atrioventricular canal (1/6 alk5 +/+, 9/10 alk5-/-; data not shown), despite an unaffected heart rate (Figure 1—figure supplement 1P).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by observational data.

claim: alk5-/- larvae lack blood flow in the trunk by 120 hpf.
source: Altogether, these defects lead to the lack of blood flow in the trunk by 120 hpf, and consequently, the death of alk5-/- larvae by 7 dpf.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text based on observations of blood flow.

claim: alk5-/- larvae die by 7 dpf.
source: Altogether, these defects lead to the lack of blood flow in the trunk by 120 hpf, and consequently, the death of alk5-/- larvae by 7 dpf.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text based on observations of larval survival.

claim: P-Smad3 immunostaining was detectable in the heart as early as 24 hpf.
source: P-Smad3 immunostaining was detectable in the heart as early as 24 hpf (Figure 2A,A'), and it persisted until 75 hpf (Figure 2—figure supplement 1C,C'), exhibiting a pattern in the OFT consistent with the expression of the Tg(SBE:EGFP) reporter (Figure 2—figure supplement 1D,D').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by immunostaining data.

claim: At 24 hpf, the p-Smad3 OFT signal was strongly enriched in ECs compared with the surrounding cells (2 ± 0.5 folds higher in ECs).
source: Of note, at 24 hpf, the p-Smad3 OFT signal was strongly enriched in ECs compared with the surrounding cells (2 ± 0.5 folds higher in ECs), while this enrichment was lost by 75 hpf (Figure 2B).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification of immunostaining data.

claim: A 1.7 ± 0.3 fold higher p-Smad3 signal was detected in OFT ECs compared with ECs in the rest of the heart.
source: Moreover, we detected a 1.7 ± 0.3 fold higher p-Smad3 signal in OFT ECs compared with ECs in the rest of the heart (Figure 2C, Figure 2—figure supplement 1E).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification of immunostaining data.

claim: As early as 24 hpf, a significant decrease in p-Smad3 immunostaining was observed in alk5-/- OFTs in both ECs and surrounding cells.
source: As early as 24 hpf, that is, before the detection of a morphological defect, we observed a significant decrease in p-Smad3 immunostaining in alk5-/- OFTs in both ECs and surrounding cells (Figure 2D–F).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by immunostaining data and quantification.

claim: Smad3 inhibition was sufficient to induce a mild OFT phenotype in alk5 heterozygotes, also preventing the formation of the VA.
source: Notably, Smad3 inhibition was sufficient to induce a mild OFT phenotype in alk5 heterozygotes, also preventing the formation of the VA (Figure 2G,H), and to exacerbate the OFT defect of alk5-/- larvae (Figure 2I–K).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by experimental data from Smad3 inhibitor treatment.

claim: Smad3 inhibition exacerbated the OFT defect of alk5-/- larvae.
source: Notably, Smad3 inhibition was sufficient to induce a mild OFT phenotype in alk5 heterozygotes, also preventing the formation of the VA (Figure 2G,H), and to exacerbate the OFT defect of alk5-/- larvae (Figure 2I–K).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by experimental data from Smad3 inhibitor treatment.

claim: No significant differences in p-Smad1/5/8 immunostaining were observed between alk5+/+ and alk5-/- embryos at 24 hpf.
source: However, we did not observe preferential activation of Smad1/5/8 in the wild-type OFT endothelium (Figure 2—figure supplement 1F) or any significant differences between alk5+/+ and alk5-/- embryos at 24 hpf (Figure 2—figure supplement 1G–I).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by immunostaining data.

claim: In alk5+/+ animals, the average number of OFT ECs increases from 21 cells at 36 hpf to 45 cells at 72 hpf.
source: In alk5+/+ animals, the average number of OFT ECs increases from 21 cells at 36 hpf to 45 cells at 72 hpf (Figure 3A,B).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by cell counting data.

claim: alk5-/- OFTs at 36 hpf were composed of an average of 22 ECs, similar to wild type.
source: Consistent with the absence of a morphological phenotype, alk5-/- OFTs at 36 hpf were composed of an average of 22 ECs, similar to wild type (Figure 3B).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by cell counting data.

claim: By 72 hpf, twice as many ECs were observed in alk5-/- OFTs compared with wild type (85 ECs).
source: However, the number of ECs in the mutant OFT diverged substantially over time, and by 72 hpf twice as many ECs were observed in alk5-/- compared with wild type (85 ECs; Figure 3B).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by cell counting data.

claim: By 36 hpf, ECs in alk5-/- OFTs were more likely to undergo cell cycle reentry than ECs in alk5+/+ OFTs.
source: In the alk5-/- OFTs, we found that, by 36 hpf, ECs were already more likely to undergo cell cycle reentry than ECs in alk5+/+ OFTs (Figure 3C–E).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by EdU labeling data.

claim: The abnormal increase in the number of EdU+ ECs in alk5-/- OFTs became even more pronounced at later stages (48–72 hpf).
source: This abnormal increase in the number of EdU+ ECs in alk5-/- OFTs became even more pronounced at later stages (48–72 hpf; Figure 3F–H).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by EdU labeling data.

claim: Treatment starting at 36 hpf with 2.5 μM of an Alk5-specific inhibitor caused increased OFT width at 54 and 78 hpf.
source: We photoconverted OFT ECs in control and Alk5 inhibitor-treated larvae; treatment starting at 36 hpf with 2.5 μM of an Alk5-specific inhibitor caused increased OFT width at 54 and 78 hpf (Figure 3—figure supplement 1A–F) as well as VA patterning defects (Figure 3—figure supplement 1D,E), thus phenocopying alk5 mutants.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by experimental data from inhibitor treatment.

claim: In wild-type fish, proximal ECs remained close to the photoconversion site up to 74 hpf.
source: In wild-type fish, proximal ECs remained close to the photoconversion site up to 74 hpf (Figure 3—figure supplement 1H,I), whereas distal ECs were invariably found in the VA (Figure 3I–J').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by photoconversion tracking data.

claim: In wild-type fish, distal ECs were invariably found in the VA.
source: In wild-type fish, proximal ECs remained close to the photoconversion site up to 74 hpf (Figure 3—figure supplement 1H,I), whereas distal ECs were invariably found in the VA (Figure 3I–J').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by photoconversion tracking data.

claim: Upon Alk5 inhibition, distal EC cells remained in the OFT.
source: In contrast, upon Alk5 inhibition, distal EC cells remained in the OFT (Figure 3—figure supplement 1L, Figure 3K,K').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by photoconversion tracking data.

claim: By 74 hpf, distal ECs in Alk5 inhibitor treated larvae were found closer to the original photoconversion site compared with control larvae.
source: By 74 hpf, these distal ECs in Alk5 inhibitor treated larvae were found closer to the original photoconversion site compared with control larvae (Figure 3L).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification of photoconversion tracking data.

claim: The OFT endothelium in 75 hpf alk5+/+ larvae is surrounded by an average of 90 ± 2 pdgfrb+ cells.
source: We observed that the OFT endothelium in 75 hpf alk5+/+ larvae is surrounded by an average of 90 ± 2 pdgfrb+ cells, organized in two to three compact layers with limited extracellular space (Figure 4A,A', C).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by cell counting data.

claim: alk5-/- larvae display a reduced number of pdgfrb+ SMCs (65 ± 2, –27%).
source: In contrast, alk5-/- larvae display a reduced number of pdgfrb+ SMCs (65 ± 2,–27%), wider extracellular space, and disorganized cell layers around the OFT (Figure 4B–C).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by cell counting data.

claim: The reduction in the total number of SMCs in alk5-/- OFTs is likely caused by a proliferation defect, as confirmed by EdU incorporation experiments (−53%; 48–72 hpf).
source: The reduction in the total number of SMCs in alk5-/- OFTs is likely caused by a proliferation defect, as confirmed by EdU incorporation experiments performed at early larval stages (−53%; 48–72 hpf, Figure 4D).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by EdU incorporation data.

claim: In alk5+/+ larvae, 77.4% of SMCs were surrounded by a continuous layer of Eln2.
source: We observed that in alk5+/+ larvae 77.4% of SMCs were surrounded by a continuous layer of Eln2, while in alk5-/- larvae only 35.8% were (Figure 4G).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification of immunostaining data.

claim: In alk5-/- larvae, only 35.8% of SMCs were surrounded by a continuous layer of Eln2.
source: We observed that in alk5+/+ larvae 77.4% of SMCs were surrounded by a continuous layer of Eln2, while in alk5-/- larvae only 35.8% were (Figure 4G).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification of immunostaining data.

claim: In alk5-/- OFTs, Eln2 localizes in small disrupted clusters, rather than in a bundle of elastic fibers as observed in alk5+/+.
source: Moreover, in alk5-/- OFTs Eln2 localizes in small disrupted clusters, rather than in a bundle of elastic fibers as observed in alk5+/+ (Figure 4E–F'').
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data.

claim: The ECM in wild-type larvae consisted mainly of thin layers.
source: At higher magnification, we observed that the ECM in wild-type larvae consisted mainly of thin layers (Figure 4J), while it consisted of broader electron-negative spaces in alk5 mutants (Figure 4K).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by TEM imaging data.

claim: The ECM in alk5 mutants consisted of broader electron-negative spaces.
source: At higher magnification, we observed that the ECM in wild-type larvae consisted mainly of thin layers (Figure 4J), while it consisted of broader electron-negative spaces in alk5 mutants (Figure 4K).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by TEM imaging data.

claim: SMCs in the external layer of the mutant OFTs exhibited cytoplasmic inclusions such as electron-dense lysosomes and double-membraned vacuoles, resembling autophagosomes.
source: Moreover, SMCs in the external layer of the mutant OFTs exhibited cytoplasmic inclusions (Figure 4I,K), such as electron-dense lysosomes (as confirmed by LysoTracker staining; Figure 4L–M'), and double-membraned vacuoles, resembling autophagosomes.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by TEM and LysoTracker staining data.

claim: Fish overexpressing alk5b in wild-type ECs reached adulthood, were fertile, and did not display obvious cardiovascular phenotypes.
source: We found that fish overexpressing alk5b in wild-type ECs reached adulthood, were fertile, and did not display obvious cardiovascular phenotypes (Figure 5—figure supplement 1A).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by observational data.

claim: When alk5b was overexpressed specifically in ECs in alk5 mutants, it was sufficient to restore cardiac function, as indicated by the lack of pericardial edema.
source: Notably, when alk5b was overexpressed specifically in ECs in alk5 mutants, it was sufficient to restore cardiac function, as indicated by the lack of pericardial edema (Figure 5B,C).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing rescue of the phenotype.

claim: alk5-/- larvae carrying the rescue transgene exhibited a wild-type morphology and function of the OFT and connecting vessels.
source: Indeed, alk5-/- larvae carrying the rescue transgene exhibited a wild-type morphology and function of the OFT and connecting vessels (Figure 5D–F), including a single VA and a wild-type like OFT expansion (Figure 5G; Figure 5—video 1).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing rescue of the phenotype.

claim: 10.2% (n = 108) of the alk5 rescued mutants inflated their swim bladder and survived until 9 days post-fertilization (dpf).
source: Occasionally, the restored cardiac function and blood flow allowed a few (10.2%, n = 108) of the alk5 rescued mutants to inflate their swim bladder and survive until 9 days post-fertilization (dpf) (Figure 5—figure supplement 1B,C).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by observational data.

claim: The number of proliferating ECs was reduced in transgenic alk5-/- larvae compared with alk5-/- not carrying the transgene.
source: In order to analyze the EC-specific OFT rescue at a cellular level, we performed EdU incorporation experiments and observed that the number of proliferating ECs was reduced in transgenic alk5-/- larvae compared with alk5-/- not carrying the transgene (Figure 5H).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by EdU incorporation data.

claim: 75 hpf transgenic alk5-/- larvae exhibited SMCs organized in multiple layers around the OFT.
source: In fact, 75 hpf transgenic alk5-/- larvae exhibited SMCs organized in multiple layers around the OFT (Figure 5K), and 71.9% of these cells were surrounded by uniform Eln2 immunostaining (Figure 5—figure supplement 1D), a percentage similar to that observed in alk5+/+ OFTs (77.6%).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data.

claim: 71.9% of SMCs in 75 hpf transgenic alk5-/- larvae were surrounded by uniform Eln2 immunostaining.
source: In fact, 75 hpf transgenic alk5-/- larvae exhibited SMCs organized in multiple layers around the OFT (Figure 5K), and 71.9% of these cells were surrounded by uniform Eln2 immunostaining (Figure 5—figure supplement 1D), a percentage similar to that observed in alk5+/+ OFTs (77.6%).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification of immunostaining data.

claim: The EC-specific overexpression of alk5b in alk5 mutants was sufficient to restore SMC proliferation to wild-type levels.
source: Moreover, the EC-specific overexpression of alk5b in alk5 mutants was sufficient to restore SMC proliferation to wild-type levels (Figure 5—figure supplement 1E).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by EdU incorporation data.

claim: Analysis of the Alk5 inhibitor-treated samples revealed 955 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), 480 of which were downregulated compared with control.
source: Analysis of the Alk5 inhibitor-treated samples revealed 955 differentially expressed genes (DEGs), 480 of which were downregulated compared with control (Supplementary file 1).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by transcriptomic analysis data.

claim: Genes downregulated upon Alk5 inhibition encode multiple ECM components and the related Gene Ontology categories are amongst the most enriched.
source: Notably, genes downregulated upon Alk5 inhibition encode multiple ECM components and the related Gene Ontology categories are amongst the most enriched (Figure 6—figure supplement 1B,C).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by Gene Ontology analysis of transcriptomic data.

claim: Five genes identified from the comparison of downregulated genes with secreted factor genes from the zebrafish matrisome were specifically expressed in the OFT in adult zebrafish.
source: Amongst the 82 genes identified, five of them were specifically expressed in the OFT in adult zebrafish (Singh et al., 2016).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by citation to expression data.

claim: The five candidate genes were decreased in alk5-/- compared with alk5+/+ larval hearts.
source: Thus, we analyzed the mRNA levels of these five genes by RT-qPCR and observed that they were also decreased in alk5-/- compared with alk5+/+ larval hearts (Figure 6—figure supplement 1E).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by RT-qPCR data.

claim: fbln5 was one of the most downregulated genes in both alk5-/- and Alk5 inhibitor-treated larvae.
source: Amongst the candidate genes, fbln5 was one of the most downregulated in both alk5-/- and Alk5 inhibitor-treated larvae (Figure 6—figure supplement 1F).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by transcriptomic and RT-qPCR data.

claim: fbln5 expression is highly enriched in the OFT at 72 hpf.
source: Importantly, we observed that fbln5 expression is highly enriched in the OFT at 72 hpf (Figure 6A,B).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by in situ hybridization data.

claim: fbln5 expression was detected in the OFT and in the first pair of aortic arches at 36 hpf.
source: To confirm its expression in ECs in zebrafish embryos, we performed in situ hybridization at 36 hpf, a stage when SMCs are not yet covering the OFT. We detected fbln5 expression in the OFT and in the first pair of aortic arches (Figure 6C,C'; Figure 6—figure supplement 2A,A'), and we further detected its expression in OFT ECs (Figure 6—figure supplement 2B', B).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by in situ hybridization data.

claim: An increase in fbln5 mRNA levels was observed in the rescued mutant hearts compared with mutant hearts not carrying the transgene.
source: Notably, we observed an increase in fbln5 mRNA levels by RT-qPCR in the rescued mutant hearts compared with mutant hearts not carrying the transgene, and the extent of this increase seemed to correlate with the level of alk5b expression in the rescued animals (Figure 6—figure supplement 2C).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by RT-qPCR data.

claim: Global overexpression of fbln5 by injecting fbln5 mRNA into alk5 mutants at the one-cell stage partially reduced the expansion of the OFT in alk5-/- animals.
source: In order to assess a potential role for Fbln5 downstream of Alk5 in the OFT, we overexpressed fbln5 globally by injecting fbln5 mRNA into alk5 mutants at the one-cell stage. Of note, this approach partially reduced the expansion of the OFT in alk5-/- animals, while it did not have an effect in wild types (Figure 6—figure supplement 2D).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by experimental data from mRNA injection.

claim: The EC-specific overexpression of fbln5 was sufficient to partially rescue OFT morphology and expansion in alk5-/- larvae.
source: Notably, the EC-specific overexpression of fbln5 was sufficient to partially rescue OFT morphology and expansion in alk5-/- larvae (Figure 6D–G), as well as VA formation.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by imaging data showing partial rescue.

claim: alk5 mutants injected with fbln5 mRNA exhibited a percentage of EdU+ ECs (16.0%), comparable with wild types (15.6%) at early embryonic stages.
source: When analyzing the cell-specific defects, we observed that alk5 mutants injected with fbln5 mRNA exhibited a percentage of EdU+ ECs (16.0%), comparable with wild types (15.6%) at early embryonic stages (Figure 6—figure supplement 2E).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by EdU incorporation data.

claim: EC-specific fbln5 overexpression in alk5 mutants led to a better organization of Eln2 immunostaining in the OFT, surrounding 58.5% of SMCs, compared with 31.1% in alk5-/- animals not carrying the transgene.
source: Importantly, EC-specific fbln5 overexpression in alk5 mutants led to a better organization of Eln2 immunostaining in the OFT, surrounding 58.5% of SMCs, compared with 31.1% in alk5-/- animals not carrying the transgene (Figure 6H–K).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification of immunostaining data.

claim: fbln5 mRNA injections into one-cell stage embryos achieved a level of rescue (56.4%) similar to EC-specific fbln5 overexpression.
source: This level of rescue was also achieved by fbln5 mRNA injections into one-cell stage embryos (56.4%; Figure 6—figure supplement 2F), suggesting that a great extent of the role of Fbln5 in the OFT can be carried out by its endothelial expression.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by quantification of immunostaining data and inference about endothelial function.

claim: Loss of Alk5 causes defects in EC proliferation during early embryonic stages.
source: We show that TGF-β signaling through Alk5 restricts EC proliferation during early embryonic stages.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text as a summary of findings.

claim: Loss of Alk5 causes defects in the SMC wall of the OFT.
source: Furthermore, loss of Alk5 causes defects in the SMC wall of the OFT.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text as a summary of findings.

claim: The combination of EC and SMC phenotypes leads to defects in OFT structural integrity, eventually resulting in vessel dissection.
source: The combination of these phenotypes leads to defects in OFT structural integrity, eventually resulting in vessel dissection, reminiscent of human pathologies.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text as a summary of findings and comparison to human disease.

claim: Restoring Alk5 expression in the endothelium is sufficient to rescue the OFT defects, including the SMC organization defects.
source: Notably, restoring Alk5 expression in the endothelium is sufficient to rescue the OFT defects, suggesting a critical role for Alk5 in ECs.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text as a summary of findings.

claim: Alk5 function has been mostly studied in vitro, where it has been shown to maintain EC quiescence.
source: In EC biology, Alk5 function has been mostly studied in vitro, where it has been shown to maintain EC quiescence (Goumans et al., 2002; Goumans et al., 2003; Lebrin et al., 2004; van Meeteren and ten Dijke, 2012; Maring et al., 2016).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by multiple citations to in vitro studies.

claim: In the zebrafish model, Alk5 plays a pivotal role in restricting EC proliferation in vivo.
source: In the zebrafish model, we confirmed a pivotal role for Alk5 in restricting EC proliferation in vivo.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text as a summary of findings.

claim: ECs lacking Alk5 function exhibited impaired movement in the OFT.
source: We found that ECs lacking Alk5 function also exhibited impaired movement in the OFT.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text as a summary of findings.

claim: The early EC defects together with the endothelial-specific rescue data suggest that ECs are primarily responsible for the OFT phenotype in alk5-/- zebrafish.
source: Importantly, the early EC defects together with the endothelial-specific rescue data suggest that ECs are primarily responsible for the OFT phenotype in alk5-/- zebrafish.
evidence: The claim is stated in the text as an interpretation of the findings.

claim: While Alk5 expression in mouse appears to be enriched in the aortic SMCs, a few studies have suggested a pivotal role for TGF-β signaling in ECs.
source: Similarly, while Alk5 expression in mouse appears to be enriched in the aortic SMCs (Seki et al., 2006), a few studies have suggested a pivotal role for TGF-β signaling in ECs (Sridurongrit et al., 2008; Bochenek et al., 2020).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by citations to mouse studies.

claim: Only EC-specific Alk5 KO mice display the early cardiovascular defects of mice carrying a global Alk5 mutation.
source: For example, although Tgfbr2 deletion in SMCs leads to OFT expansion in mouse (Jaffe et al., 2012), only EC-specific Alk5 KO mice display the early cardiovascular defects of mice carrying a global Alk5 mutation (Carvalho et al., 2007; Sridurongrit et al., 2008; Dave et al., 2018).
evidence: The claim is stated in the text and supported by citations to mouse studies.

claim: Both mice and patients exhibiting aneurysms display a hyperactivation of downstream TGF-β signaling, despite carrying loss-of-function mutations in TGF-β genes.
source: Remarkably, both mice and patients exhibiting aneurysms display a hyperactivation of downstream TGF-β signaling, despite carrying loss-of-function mutations in TGF-β genes (Jones et al., 2009; Mallat et al., 2017; Takeda et al., 2018).
